dogecoin.text:
I don't mean to brag (sure) but my little #Dogecoin investment has nearly doubled in the last 3 weeks.

If it doubles again I'll have enough to buy a 12-pack of Natty!!

Storyline:
You know, had I invested 1 MILLION dollars into #Dogecoin a few weeks ago I'd have over 2 MILLION dollars now.

Alt Storyline:
Had I invested 1 MILLION dollars in #Dogecoin a few weeks ago I'd have 10 dollars now.

I just bought a few packages of Man Panties and paid for the overnight shipping option...

...my #Dogecoin riches have gone to my head!!

I just heard an "economist" on the radio say that IF you invest in cryptocurrency that it should be no more than 1% of your net worth...

...and now I'm mad as I see my #Dogecoin investment triple in value!!

Dear ALL wypipo,
Today is #CincodeMayo, no, it is NOT Mexican Independence Day! Please respect my culture and do NOT eat our food or drink our beer and alcohol unless you purchase a Cultural Pass from an actual Latinx/Hispanx representative - like ME! I accept #Dogecoin.
I just realized that saying: "I bought #Dogecoin when it was <insert price>." is the new "I do crossfit" or "I'm a vegan." or even worse: "I'm fully vaxxed!!"

"The lord Elon giveth, the lord Elon taketh away..."

-me looking at my #Dogecoin
I could buy a house or I could buy more Dogecoin...

@GingyNorth I invested in #Dogecoin and almost made a couple grand but then effin' Elon went on SNL and STOLE my money!

Why, you have a guaranteed money maker?

I had a few dollars to play with and "I f*cked around and bought some #Dogecoin" last year. It did nothing but trend up for weeks. I was on vacation by the pool and decided to check on it - up almost 10x!!

That night Elon went on SNL, said something, and tanked it!

Today: $124!

It would appear that my tweet about Elon sinking #Dogecoin has prompted him to action!

**adds #Influencer to bio**
